collection.description: A solitary explorer believes an ancient guardian lives behind a waterfall.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A solitary explorer believes an ancient guardian lives behind a waterfall.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The group finds a hidden nesting site but no guardian.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An unfamiliar echo follows them out, unsettling everyone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The explorer returns with a curious mineral sample.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The explorer goes missing, and a rescue party finds only abandoned supplies.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The waterfall remains a site of quiet reflection.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A younger villager protests that reverence should not forbid curiosity.
